description_en: Retrieves the details of a host account on a host managed by a Bastionhost instance, such as the protocol type and account name
description_zh: 获取指定主机账户详情
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost get-host-account --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --host-account-id 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetHostAccount

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Bastionhost instance where the host account that you want to query resides.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的主机账户所在堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Bastionhost instance where the host account that you want to query resides.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的主机账户所在堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the host account that you want to query.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204372.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的主机账户ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204372.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: host_account_id

HostAccount.description_en: The detailed information about the queried host account
HostAccount.description_zh: 查询到的主机账户详细信息

HasPassword.description_en:
Indicates whether a password is set for the host account. Valid values:

true: A password is set.

false: No password is set
HasPassword.description_zh:
主机账户是否设置密码。取值：

true：已设置密码。
false：未设置密码

HostAccountId.description_en: The ID of the host account

HostAccountName.description_en: The name of the host account

HostId.description_en: The ID of the host to which the host account belongs

HostShareKeyId.description_en: The ID of the shared key for the host

HostShareKeyName.description_en: The name of the shared key for the host

PrivateKeyFingerprint.description_en: The fingerprint information of the private key

PrivilegeType.description_en:
The permission type of the account.

Privileged: Privileged account

Normal: Regular account

This parameter is supported only in V3.2.47 and later
PrivilegeType.description_zh:
账户权限类型。
Privileged：特权账户
Normal：普通账户
仅支持V3.2.47及以上的版本使用

ProtocolName.description_en:
The protocol name of the host account. Valid values:

SSH

RDP
ProtocolName.description_zh:
主机账户的协议名称。取值：

SSH
RDP

RotationMode.description_en:
The password rotation mode of the account.

Privileged: Use a privileged account to rotate passwords

Self: Do not use a privileged account to rotate passwords

This parameter is supported only in V3.2.47 and later
RotationMode.description_zh:
账户改密模式。
Privileged：使用特权账户改密
Self：不使用特权账户改密
仅支持V3.2.47及以上的版本使用

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符
